ticker: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall on India's east coast
OpenAI plans to purchase Google AI chips
Saudi refinery attacked, reigniting global oil supply concerns
India invites Pakistan minister for SCO dialogue
Flávio Bolsonaro flees to US following election defeat

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab Makes Landfall on India's East Coast
articles.brief: Cyclone Arnab has made landfall near Andhra Pradesh, triggering heavy rainfall, strong winds, and widespread disruptions. Authorities have evacuated nearly 90,000 residents, deployed extra emergency forces, and suspended key rail and flight services across coastal districts in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

articles.headline: OpenAI Reportedly Plans to Purchase Google AI Chips
articles.brief: OpenAI is reportedly planning to acquire custom AI chips from Google, diversifying its hardware supply chain as the artificial intelligence race intensifies. This development follows OpenAI's recent announcements regarding custom processing hardware initiatives designed to meet escalating infrastructure demands.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabian Refinery Hit, Renewing Global Supply Concerns
articles.brief: Crude oil prices surged after a drone attack targeted a major Saudi Arabian refinery, intensifying geopolitical supply worries in the Middle East. Yemen's Houthis claimed responsibility for the strike, raising immediate alarms across international energy markets.

articles.headline: India Invites Pakistan Minister for SCO Civilisational Dialogue
articles.brief: In a notable diplomatic shift, India has invited a Pakistani minister to attend the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi scheduled for November. Prime Minister Modi is set to inaugurate the event alongside representatives from over 25 nations.

articles.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro Flees to US Following Election Defeat
articles.brief: Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, fled to Florida following a stunning election defeat and impending criminal investigations. Brazilian President Lula da Silva strongly condemned the departure as shameful.

articles.headline: India Among Top Nations with High Infant Heatwave Exposure
articles.brief: A comprehensive new global report highlights India as one of the leading countries facing extreme heatwave exposure risks among infants and older adults, underscoring urgent public health vulnerabilities driven by climate change.

articles.headline: Abhishek Sharma Smashes World Record in New Zealand T20I
articles.brief: Indian cricketer Abhishek Sharma broke Rohit Sharma's all-time international record for most sixes in a calendar year during a dominant T20 victory over New Zealand. Sharma smashed 113 runs off 38 balls to secure a commanding series sweep.

articles.headline: Trump Drastically Loosens Biden-Era Federal Methane Regulations
articles.brief: The Trump administration has announced a sweeping relaxation of strict Biden-era methane emission regulations, citing potential corporate savings of billions. Environmental groups immediately raised concerns over increased greenhouse gas emissions.
